summary: PLAN_ID toolchain-workflow-repair; CLI requires repository root, plan directory, canonical output path, skill-input receipt, and current-round plan-validation receipt; validates contract, plan/resume state, and skill-input readiness; only plan-ready state may transition, while authorized state requires explicit successor-refresh flag and immutable predecessor copy; binds contract, registries, manifests, context/freeze, validation, repair artifacts, validators, predecessor, and skill-input generation hashes; writes implementation-authorized state and receipt; appends authorization report; authorizes implementation-authorized only; explicitly excludes completion, acceptance, knowledge publication, bootstrap review, and release; output is canonical successor receipt; ambiguity: predecessor fallback filename contains fixed hash, and receipt includes an unusual redacted-key field.
